means: Light broken into scattered patches and blobs by something in front of it - almost always leaves. The shadow arrives as a PATTERN, not as a single edge.
does: Scatters soft-edged bright patches across faces, ground and clothing, and drags a whole context in with it: trees, summer, outdoors, afternoon. One of the strongest tags in this set, because it names an object the model has drawn thousands of times (leaf shadows) rather than a property of light, and dappled sunlight is well-trained danbooru vocabulary. It belongs to the gobo family - a pattern cut into the light before it lands - which this project rates the highest value per token available in tag space, since two words buy you a whole location.
reach_for_it: when a scene sits outdoors under trees, or when a flat interior needs a shape across it and you cannot afford a new location
used_in: the foliage option of studio/cards/light_shadow_gobo.json ('dappled shadows, leaf shadows, dappled light')
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
